reader_questions.question: What changes when an edit protects another output?
reader_questions.mechanism: Target equality and protected directions constrain the same update. Compatible constraints intersect; protecting the target makes the requested change infeasible.

reader_questions.question: How does a candidate become an evaluated artifact?
reader_questions.mechanism: The caller validates and ranks candidates, records selection, seals it, and supplies evaluation results. The receipt binds records; it does not attest historical execution.

reader_questions.question: What did the original report and local study establish?
reader_questions.mechanism: Separate original tasks and restrictions from local synthetic output-head studies, retain negative/no-op outcomes, and report the target-retention tradeoff with normalized errors and uncertainty.

reader_questions.question: Which premises support a guarantee?
reader_questions.mechanism: Feature-span and sequential real-valued results depend on declared endpoints, coordinates, domains, and hypotheses. Runtime extraction, compilation, native arithmetic, and candidate-to-proof binding remain separate obligations.

reader_questions.question: What evidence is needed next?
reader_questions.mechanism: Define questions, controls, fresh units, access conditions, and acceptance/rejection criteria before claiming stronger scope.

applied: Factual fidelity and requested scope precede clarity and style.
Start with a supplied concrete example, show intermediate states, and explain the mechanism before generalizing.
Keep baselines, units, populations, uncertainty, contrary outcomes, and attribution attached to findings.
Distinguish authored illustrations, recorded observations, conditional mathematical results, interpretation, and proposed work.
Use a useful reader-controlled visual with inspectable model assumptions and static reading; test the actual artifact and record untested surfaces.
Assess the explanation by supported conclusions and usable reader actions, not document length, test totals, theorem totals, or a readability score.

guidance.upstream_reuse: Guidance and examples were read. No upstream runtime or figures were copied into the explanation; pinned repository paths and content identities record the sources.

core_documentation.assessment: Supported claims, evidence identity, explicit limits, runnable examples, and usable reader actions. No word, test, or theorem total is used as a quality threshold.

limitations: This documentation receipt summarizes checks with different scopes. Their totals are not a measure of correctness, scientific strength, or explanation quality.
No new scientific population, live LLM/provider run, or Lean elaboration is reported here. Historical evidence retains its original identities and boundaries.
The exact toy model, useful edit, and analytic session rows are supplied. Zero toy errors do not establish autonomous discovery or experimental confirmation.

Native keyboard activation and slider drag were not verified. No touch, screen-reader/accessibility certification, user-learning evaluation, or full offline-disconnection test was performed. Print emulation does not establish PDF pagination.
The unusable tiled full-page screenshot and the pre-layout observations are retained with their actual limitations. Final viewport captures bind the reviewed layout.

Fresh core installation used the configured Microsoft mirror on the recorded Windows/Python/NumPy environment without Torch. Public-PyPI portability and every supported platform/optional dependency are not established by it.
Local destination/fragment checks do not validate external URLs or unpublished release assets. Their actual publication and remote outcomes require separate records.
The optional STE engine validators were not run. Authored artifact review is not ASD-STE100 certification, factual attestation, or a guarantee of comprehension.
browser_limitations: Native keyboard Enter/Space activation and native slider pointer/drag automation focused controls without triggering expected default action; keyboard and drag behavior remain unverified. This did not establish an artifact-handler bug.
Touch interaction and screen-reader behavior were not tested; no accessibility-conformance claim.
A raw debugger input-dispatch attempt was rejected as unsupported; no bypass used.

Read-only evaluation did not expose performance for resource timing. Resource-tree observation and the static absence of external script/style/image URLs are narrower checks; no full offline-disconnection test.
The full-page screenshot duplicated tiles and is retained as an unusable capture attempt. Viewport captures support the visual review.
Print checks used screen emulation, not PDF output or pagination.
An earlier reset comparison was falsely rejected because object keys had different insertion order; a canonical-key comparison corrected the harness and passed.
No STE engine validator, teaching-efficacy study, scientific experiment, or proof build ran as part of this browser review.

limits: Saved evidence is replayed; no worlds, initial weights, proposals, or optimization paths are regenerated.
Random stream declarations and distribution support are checked, but RNG seed-to-sample generation is not independently verified.
Training and solver optimality are not proved. Recorded fit ranks/condition numbers and gradient histories are not fully recomputed; nullspace anchor rank is recomputed.
Numerical output replay uses independent Python equations but shares NumPy and, for native CPU execution/casts, PyTorch with the study.
Floating observations use atol=1e-12 and rtol=1e-10. Endpoint hashes, literal edits, types, counters, and rational certificate payloads use exact checks.
Exact rational receipt replay does not verify the feature extractor, all-input floating execution, Python implementation, or an optimizer.
The formal Lean build and axiom audit have separate receipts and are not rerun by this auditor.
Freeze hashes and declared chronology are provenance checks, not trusted timestamps, security attestation, or proof that frozen source was executed.
Current repository source differences are informational; frozen copies and persisted evidence are the audit inputs.
Complete successful session traces are supported. Failure traces and incomplete studies cannot receive a fully passed audit.
Bootstrap intervals describe saved synthetic worlds and do not establish population, real-data, large-model, or language-model programming claims.
